review.summary: Five encoded frames confirm the planned foundation-two transfers, single in-place counters, and reduced tableau stacks. This is a deterministic motion concept, not a Unity runtime recording.
fidelity_limits: Family is translated rigidly from column two to crown foundation two; Sister then moves rigidly from column one to that same Family foundation. No scaling, rotation, shadow, glow, bevel or camera movement is added.

The two removed top cards reduce the affected tableau columns from four visible cards to three: two back strips and one newly exposed flower face. Peony appears under Family; Lily appears under Sister.
Moves is replaced in place: 190→189→188. The one Family counter is replaced in place: 0/8→1/8 only after Sister arrives. No added number appears on either flower.
The selected v3 source has slight fill variation. Existing art and local background patches retain that variation; animation effects are only solid ink lines.

Peony and Lily illustrations are cropped from the prior AI video, whose flower identities were correct. All wrong destinations, counters, stack states and generated pointers from that video are discarded. Hidden faces are composited concept art, not a Unity runtime capture.
No new tutorial hand or pointer, HUD badge, victory, completion, draw or reward is added. The remaining tableau, footer and selected source layout remain fixed.

Small background/card-edge compositing differences can be visible at close inspection. Flower illustration crops are concept art drawn by the prior AI video; source data verifies their identities, not these exact glyphs or artwork.
review.audio: Exact plan narration with installed Samantha voice and original synthesized stereo effects/music.
review.gameplay: At 4.8s, Family occupies foundation 2, remains 0/8, Moves is 189, and column 2 has two backs plus Peony. At 6.6s Sister is moving from column 1 toward Family. At 8.5s and 11.5s, Family has only 1/8, Moves 188, and both affected columns contain two backs plus their Lily/Peony face. Aunt, Ketchup, cat and remaining columns stay unchanged.
review.flatness: Cards translate without scaling, rotation, shadow, glow or added bevel. Only short solid ink contact marks are introduced. Existing source tonal fill variation remains.
review.text: One Family counter updated in place. No duplicate 0/8, stray Peony numeral, or added flower-name labels. Counter glyphs are locally redrawn, so their font is an approximation of the selected art.
review.technical_check: 12.000s ; 1080×1920 ; 360 H.264 frames at 30 fps ; AAC stereo 48 kHz. Exact supplied narration synthesized with the installed Samantha voice.

review.summary: Recognizable two-card demonstration, but it misses the specified destination and has persistent count/text drift. It does not satisfy strict flat/state-fidelity acceptance.
review.visual_review: Seven encoded frames at 0, 2.5, 4.5, 6.5, 8, 10 and 11.79 seconds were compared with selected flat v3 and the verified action plan.
review.gameplay: Family lands in the third crown foundation instead of the specified second. The final card retains 0/8 while adding 1/8 below it; an unauthorized 1 appears on Peony. Peony and Lily reveal with three back-card strips still visible in each affected column, so visible stack count does not decrease after removing the prior top card. Moves 190→189→188 and the Peony/Lily identities are correct. No category completion or victory is shown.
review.layout: Five foundations, five tableau columns, fixed overall framing, remaining card identities, and footer are recognizable. New hand pointer appears despite no pointer in the selected opening image and returns during the requested final hold.
review.flatness: Added white circular pickup halo, translucent white drag ribbon, and bright raised-looking Family card edging depart from strict opaque flat rendering. The selected still itself retains gentle fill variation, which is not newly attributed to this video.
review.text: Persistent duplicate 0/8 plus 1/8; unauthorized 1 on Peony. Peony/Lily word labels are added alongside the source-required flower icons.
review.audio_review: Audio stream is present; this review did not listen to or transcribe it, so exact narration and sound quality are unverified.
review.recommendation: Prefer a deterministic local animation for these two rigid card moves, exact second-foundation placement, exact 190→189→188 and 0/8→1/8 replacements, and a locked flat background. Any further model retry should first remove legacy shadow/glint/pulse wording from the embedded action presentations, but could still drift counts and geometry.
